column3: (Cache-control: GitHub Pages sets caching; no private pages are cached)
(Cross-domain JS: Firebase SDK from gstatic.com and Google Translate, allowed by CSP)
(Anti-clickjacking header: Pages cannot set headers; app.js refuses to run in a frame)
(HSTS: set by GitHub Pages only for github.io; HTTPS is enforced for the custom domain)
(Storable and cacheable content: public static pages)
(CSP via <meta> cannot define frame-ancestors; covered by app.js frame check)
(Cross-domain misconfiguration: public static files with Access-Control-Allow-Origin *)
(SRI: Firebase SDK is loaded with dynamic import(), which cannot carry integrity)
(COEP: would block Google sign-in and Translate)
